Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:11:1.hebrew: נהוריתא - מוליי"א בלע"ז, היוצאת בשחור העין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:11:1.english: Nehorita - Maille in Old French [a white spot], which emerges on the black [pupil] of the eye.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:12:1.english: Worm rot on the king's clothing - I saw a moth that eats the silks of the king's treasury.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:12:3.english: On gold garments - Woolen garments dyed red.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:12:4.english: And they killed him - For a moth does not eat linen garments.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:13:1.english: But [in a case of] public service that does not return - It is [considered] like [a case where] it died or broke [a limb].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:14:1.english: If it was taken in the direction it was going - For the impressment [service] leads it along the road that this [renter] wanted to go.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:15:1.english: It became blinded or went mad - It is still fit for his burden.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:15:2.hebrew: אומר לו הרי שלך לפניך - שכן דרך אנגריא: נוטל חמורו של זה ומהלך בעליה אחריה, וכל חמור שפוגע בו ראשון נוטלו ומחזיר לו את שלו, והשני חוזר אחר חמורו עד שפוגע באחר. הלכך, אומר לו: הואיל ואף מזלך גרם, שכור חמור אחר ולך אחריו עד שיפגע בחמור אחר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:15:2.english: He says to him, "That which is yours is before you" - For such is the way of royal requisition [angarya]: [the officer] takes this person's donkey and its owner walks after it, and whatever donkey he encounters first, he takes it and returns his own [donkey] to him, and the second [owner] goes after his donkey until he encounters another. Therefore, he says to him: "Since your misfortune also caused [this], hire another donkey and go after him until he encounters another donkey."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:16:1.hebrew: בשלמא לרב לא קשיא - רומיא דמתניתין אהדדי, דמצי לשנויי: כאן בחוזרת וכו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:16:1.english: Granted, according to Rav it is not difficult - [i.e.,] the contradiction of the teachings against one another, for he can answer: here [it refers] to a returning [impressment], etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:1:1.hebrew: נקרא גזלן - וקמה ליה ברשותיה להתחייב בכל אונסיה, וסיפא רבנן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:1:1.english: Is called a robber - And it stands in his possession to become liable for all its unavoidable accidents, and the latter clause [is the opinion of] the Rabbis.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:2:1.hebrew: נותן לו דמי צמרו - בדמים שצמר לבן נמכר בשוק, דקנייה בגזלו לשלם כשעת הגזילה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:2:1.english: He gives him the value of his wool - At the price for which white wool is sold in the market, for he acquired it through his robbery, to pay according to [its value at] the time of the robbery.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:3:1.english: The expenses - The cost of wood and dyes, and not a full wage.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:4:1.hebrew: בשינוי - ששינהו מכמות שהיה, ואיכא למאן דאמר שינוי קונה בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק ק:), אבל גבי החמור לא נשתנה החמור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:4:1.english: By means of a physical change - For he changed it from what it was, and there is one who says [that] a physical change acquires [the item], in [the chapter] HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 100b); whereas regarding the donkey, the donkey was not changed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:1.english: The Purim collection [is] for Purim - Money that the [charity] collectors collect from the residents of the city to distribute to the poor for the Purim feast.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:2.english: For Purim - All of it they shall give to the poor of Purim.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:3.hebrew: ואין מדקדקין - לומר דיים בפחות, והמותר יפול לכיס של צדקה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:3.english: And one does not scrutinize - to say [that] less is sufficient for them, and the remainder should go to the charity fund.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:4.english: But they buy the calves - In abundance, with all the money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:5.hebrew: והמותר - שלא יספיקו לאכול בפורים, ימכור ויפול לכיס של צדקה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:5:5.english: And the remainder - [Of the meat] that they do not manage to eat on Purim, he sells, and [the proceeds] go to the charity fund.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:7:1.hebrew: אדעתא דמידי אחרינא לא יהיב ליה - וכיון דלאו אדעתא דהכי יהיב, נמצא מעות בחזקת בעלים, חוץ מן היוצאין בסעודת פורים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:7:1.english: He did not give [it] to him with the intent [that it be used] for anything else - And since he did not give [it] with this intent, it turns out [that] the money is in the possession of the owners, except for what is spent on the Purim feast.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:9:1.hebrew: דאתו למיחשדיה - לבעל הבית בנודר ואינו מקיים, ששמעו עליו שאמר ליקח טלית לפלוני עני ולא קנה לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 78b:9:1.english: As they will come to suspect him - [Namely,] the homeowner, as one who vows and does not fulfill [it], for they heard about him that he said [he would] buy a cloak for such-and-such a poor person, and he did not buy [it] for him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:12:1.hebrew: במילתא דמלכא - אית דגרס "במולתא". פירוש: היינו פרדס, כמו (שבת ד' נב.) "מולאות של בית רבי". "בטלי זהב או בטלי כסף" — כלומר: פרדות אדומות או לבנות. ואין נראה לר"י, דבלשון ארמי לא קרי להו אלא כודנייתא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:12:1.english: On the king's meilata - Some read b'multa. Explanation: this is pardes [an apparent textual error for peradim, "mules"], as in (Shabbat 52a): "the mules [mula'ot] of the house of Rabbi." "On golden talei or on silver talei" — that is to say, red or white female mules. However, this does not appear [correct] to R"I, because in the Aramaic language they are only called kudanyata [mules].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:13:1.hebrew: באנגריא חוזרת - דיכול לעשות מלאכתו כשתחזור, אע"פ שתתאחר במלאכתו; שבשביל איחור אין חייב להעמיד לו חמור אחר, כמו הבריקה או נשתטתה, שמתאחרת נמי במלאכתה ולא חיישינן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:13:1.english: With regard to temporary public service - Because [the renter] can perform his work when it returns, even though it will be delayed in his work; for on account of a delay, [the owner] is not obligated to provide him with another donkey, just like [the cases where] it became blind or went mad, where it is also delayed in its work and we are not concerned.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:18:1.hebrew: אם בדרך הליכתה ניטלה אומר לו הרי שלך לפניך - פירש בקונטרס: שמוליכה בדרך שגם הוא רוצה לילך, אומר לו משכיר: "הרי שלך לפניך, ושכור בהמה אחרת עד שם". ותימה: דלמה ישכור בהמה אחרת? ואם השוכר אין צריך החמור בהליכה אלא בחזרה, הוי א"ש; אבל אם כן, בגופה ה"ל לפלוגי, בין צריך חמור לאלתר לאין צריך אלא בחזרה. ונראה כפי' ר"ח, דמפרש: "אם בדרך הליכה" — שהאנגריא אין מחפשין בבתים אלא כשפוגעים בדרך, והיינו "דרך הליכתה", אומר לו משכיר: "הרי שלך לפניך", דמצי א"ל: "מזלך גרם, שאילו היתה בבית לא היתה ניטלת". ואפילו אינה חוזרת, דלא דמי למתה, דהכא מוכח דמזלא דידיה גורם. ואם שלא בדרך הליכתה ניטלת — דהיינו שמחפשין גם בבתים, שאז לא מזלו של שוכר גורם — חייב להעמיד לו חמור אחר לעשות מלאכתו לאלתר; דאפילו חוזרת האנגריא את החמור לכאן בעוד שתועיל חזרתה לשוכר, אין לו לשוכר להתעכב ממלאכתו, ולא דמי להבריקה או נשתטתה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:18:1.english: "If it was seized on the way of its walking, he says to him: 'That which is yours is before you'" - Rashi explained: [This means] that [the royal requisition] takes it along the road that he [the renter] also wants to go; the lessor says to him, "That which is yours is before you, and hire another animal until there." And this is astonishing: why should he have to hire another animal? Now, if the renter does not need the donkey on the outbound journey, only on the return, it would work out well; but if so, [the baraita] should have distinguished in [that] very case between where he needs a donkey immediately and where he only needs [it] on the return. Rather, it appears [correct] like the explanation of Rabbeinu Chananel, who explains: "If [it was seized] while walking on the road" — meaning that the angaria [royal requisitioners] do not search in houses, only when they encounter [animals] on the road, and that is [the meaning of] "the way of its walking" — the lessor says to him, "That which is yours is before you," because he can say to him, "Your mazal [misfortune] caused it, for had it been in the house it would not have been seized." And [this applies] even if it does not return, for it is not similar to [the case where the donkey] died, since here it is evident that his [own] mazal is the cause. And if it was seized not while walking on the road — that is, where they search in houses as well, in which case it is not the renter's mazal that causes [it] — he is obligated to provide him with another donkey to do his work immediately; for even if the angaria returns the donkey here while its return would still be of use to the renter, the renter does not have to delay his work, and it is not similar to [the cases where the donkey] went blind or went mad.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:18:2.hebrew: מכלל דתנא קמא לא שני ליה - ות"ק עדיף, דהוי רבים לגבי יחיד:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:18:2.english: "By inference, according to the first tanna there is no difference" - And the first tanna is preferable, for he is the majority against an individual.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:5:1.hebrew: מגבת פורים לפורים - וא"ת: דאמרינן בערכין (ד' ו:), מעות של צדקה מותר לשנותן בכל מה שירצה, ואפילו באו לידי גבאי, ואפילו אמר מנורה זו לבד"ה, מותר לשנותה למצוה אחרת. וי"ל: דדוקא בפורים אמרינן הכא דאין לשנות, ו"מגבת העיר לאותה העיר" נמי דפורים דוקא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:5:1.english: "Purim collection for Purim" - And if you ask: We say in Arakhin (6b) [that] charity money may be diverted to whatever [purpose] one wishes, even if it has [already] come into the hands of the charity collector, and even if one said, "This candelabrum is for a synagogue," it is permitted to divert it to another mitzvah! And one can answer: It is specifically regarding Purim that we say here that one may not divert [it], and "the city collection is for that city" also [refers] specifically to Purim.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:6:1.hebrew: רבי אליעזר אומר מגבת פורים לפורים - ת"ק לא איירי אלא בגבאי דלא ישנה, ור' אליעזר איירי בעני שנתנו לו מעות לצורך סעודת פורים, שאינו רשאי העני לשנות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 78b:6:1.english: "Rabbi Eliezer says: The Purim collection is for Purim" - The first Tanna is speaking only of the charity collector, that he may not divert [the funds], whereas Rabbi Eliezer is speaking of a poor person to whom they gave money for the purpose of the Purim feast, [teaching] that the poor person is not permitted to divert [it].
